scope: Independent native source-column authority for judicial record boundaries. Native-only; no OCR/model changes.
source_diagnosis: Centered nominal court signatures, addresses wider than the signature, flush body/header margins and adjacent-column continuations without a repeated category caption are valid source layouts. A signature right edge alone is not the column right edge.
rules: Keep the existing formal case-identifier and nominal court-signature grammar, complete native font-role/word evidence, quotation/body-role/enclosure authority and strict legacy unruled-layout proof. No new content dispatch string is added.

An independent column certificate uses full original vertical separators spanning all used native baselines, complete finite original glyph bounds/directions/baselines, a unique containing adjacent rail pair and no original used word crossing its walls. Unknown/compatibility evidence declines.

A proven column can hold a centered or left-aligned signature and a wider following address. The body may align with its header but cannot precede the header source margin. Original signature/header/body order and disjoint native font roles still apply.

A column transition without a repeated caption requires adjacent original columns, the old signature at the final source baseline of its column and the new header/caption at the first source baseline of the next. Intervening or unknown native words decline.

Larger source captions retain the existing font/size hierarchy, ordering, baseline and separator/enclosure proofs. Original column edges, when independently proven, supply their physical right boundary.
All PageTrace/material remains exact; old articles are split in place into exact contiguous native text partitions. No old article boundary may be crossed or merged.
